transitions.label: 5d7.6s2 a 4F9/2 - 5d7.6s.(5F).6p z 6F°11/2, 351.365 nm (air)
transitions.use: 351 nm line (to the lowest odd J=11/2 level) used for laser-spectroscopy isotope shifts of the Ir chain A = 182-193 at ISOLDE (Verney et al., Eur. Phys. J. A 30 (2006), as described in Schiffmann & Godefroid, arXiv:2008.07602; the measured shifts themselves were not read)

transitions.label: 5d7.6s2 a 4F9/2 - 40389.83 cm-1 level, J=9/2 (odd), 247.587 nm (vacuum)
transitions.use: first-step line of the in-gas-cell laser resonance ionization spectroscopy of 196,197,198Ir at KISS (Mukai et al., Phys. Rev. C 102, 054307 (2020)), used for charge radii and deformations (per Schiffmann & Godefroid, arXiv:2008.07602)

193-191.note: theory, field shift only (mass shift stated to be much smaller): -8.1 GHz from the calculated electronic factor with Breit and QED corrections and a model radius formula; -7.1 GHz without those corrections; -7.7 / -6.7 GHz from the 'variational' two-isotope calculation. Negative = lower frequency for the heavier isotope. A measured value exists (Mukai et al. 2020) but could not be opened.
193-191.source: Schiffmann & Godefroid, 'Electronic isotope shift factors for the Ir 5d7 6s2 4F9/2 -> (odd, J = 9/2) line at 247.587 nm', arXiv:2008.07602v2 (2020), section 4.4
